subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 3: Story – I haven't got my bag! + Sound h
outcomes: I can say book, crayon, pencil and pencil case.
I can say I've got … and I haven't got …, and I look after my things.
I can say the sound /h/ and read hat and hit.

tf.s: In the story, Fatma hasn't got her school bag at school.
tf.why: Yes! That is the story title: I haven't got my bag!

tf.s: In the story, Meg has got the bag.
tf.why: Yes! Meg the cat has got it.

tf.s: We should leave our things everywhere.
At the end, Fatma says: I look after my things!
tf.why: Great! That is the story value.

tf.s: A crayon is a family word.
tf.why: A crayon is a school thing.

tf.s: We put pencils in a pencil case.
tf.why: Yes! A pencil case keeps pencils safe.

tf.s: Hen starts with the letter m.

boxes.why: The story is I haven't got my bag!
Meg the cat has got the bag.

boxes.q: The /h/ Phonics Card shows a boy …

hunt.q: Catch the school thing we read.
Catch the school thing for colouring.
Catch the thing that holds pencils.
Catch the cat in the story.

mcq.q: Which one is a new school thing in this story?
mcq.why: Pencil case is a school thing.
The value is Look after your things.

mcq.q: Which of these words starts with /h/?
Your pencil case is open on the floor. What do you do?
o: Pick it up and close it.

mcq.q: You have crayons but no book. You say …
o: I've got crayons. I haven't got a book.
mcq.why: Say what you have and what you don't have.

mcq.q: _ot: the word is hot. Which letter is missing?
Why is it good to look after your things?
mcq.why: When we look after things, we keep them safe.

mcq.q: Which word does NOT start with /h/?
Which word does not belong: book, pencil, crayon, horse?
